org.openpe.pebench-example.qualification: Educational source example; not a qualified PEBench production or zero-DRC sample.

sourceDRC.basis: Standalone-board KiCad defaults/imported board settings; zones refilled in memory; source project rule equivalence not established.

org.openpe.pebench-example.changes: EAGLE schematic converted with original embedded symbol geometry, gates and physical pin mappings; PEBench KiCad PCB represented as editable structured geometry. Native source files and notices retained. Polygon curves in schematic artwork tessellated within 0.005 mm. PCB zone boundaries and settings retained; cached zone fill is regenerated by KiCad. No simulation profile is added.
